# 1 Clement Chapter 63 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 63 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_063_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 63

**63:1** Therefore it is right for us to be attentive to so many and such great examples and to bow the neck in submission — that is, to practice obedience — so that, laying aside the futile sedition, we may attain without any reproach to the goal set before us in truth.

**63:2** For you will afford us joy and gladness if you obey what we have written through the Holy Spirit, and if you uproot the unlawful passion of your jealousy, in accordance with the entreaty for peace and harmony which we have penned in this letter.

**63:3** We have also sent to you faithful and prudent men, who from youth to old age have lived virtuously among us, and they shall be witnesses between you and us.

**63:4** This we have done so that you may know that our entire concern has been and is that you may swiftly attain peace.

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
